thread: sam: FYI the prod docs build is failing with fragment mismatches after the mkdocs -> mdx conversion. Linkcheck flags fragments that exist in rendered HTML but not in the static anchor list. docs-bot: mkdocs-linkcheck failed: 6 broken fragments found. See CI artifact. sam: Quick snippet from the log: ERROR - file:///workspace/site/reference/plugins.html: broken link: /docs/reference/plugins#plugin-config -> fragment not found priya: I inspected the generated HTML for that page and found the heading present, but the slug has an extra invisible char (U+200E, LEFT-TO-RIGHT MARK) embedded. The source heading was copied from a vendor example. sam: Oh nice catch. So the slugifier is honestly doing its job but the source contains directional/invisible marks. We need a fix that prevents future copies from introducing flakes. priya: Proposed triage: 1) short-term: add explicit fallback anchors for the high-traffic pages to unblock release (e.g., ""), marked with a comment. 2) medium-term: add a pre-commit/CI lint to detect Unicode control chars in `.md`/`.mdx`. 3) long-term: run a one-off repo normalization to strip LTR/RTL marks and document the policy in CONTRIBUTING.md. qa: For the short-term anchors, please include mobile QA steps (scroll-to anchor verification in mobile Safari/Chrome). We saw offsets previously. sam: I'll open the content PR for fallbacks, include CI ignore rule for these fragments until the pre-commit lands. Priya can own the lint + normalization script. priya: I'll implement a small Node script `scripts/check-control-chars.js` that searches for code points: U+200E, U+200F, U+200B, and flags any files. Will add a unit test too. sam: Who's adding the linkcheck ignore? I can add a temporary pattern to `.linkcheck-ignore` limited to the affected pages. Keep it timeboxed in the PR. priya: PRs opened: content fallback PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1988; control-char lint and CI test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1989. Both include descriptions and screenshots. ci-bot: docs PR #1988 checks started. qa: I'll run through the manual anchor tests on staging once CI passes. If offsets are off, we'll add a small CSS scroll-margin fix for h2/h3. sam: Plan recap: add temporary anchors + linkcheck ignore (PR 1988), land control-char lint + CI test (PR 1989), run repo cleanup, then remove temporary anchors in a follow-up revert PR. priya: Also adding a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about avoiding paste from unknown sources and running `npm run docs-check` locally. sam: Thanks, folks. Please drop the PR links here as they update and ping when staging linkcheck passes. :thumbsup:
